pinned_revision_note: Repo tree was dirty at freeze time from SIBLING experiments' untracked directories (parallel agents). Validity is gated on the authored blob hashes below, not on git status of the whole tree or on live HEAD at run time, per SUBAGENT_BRIEF.md.

target.note: A18 Pro is HANDS-OFF; no A18 claim anywhere in this experiment.

case_matrix.generation: deterministic, seeded (harness/casematrix.py SEED=0x0E1210121); byte-identical between run01 and run02

raw_record_schema.01_results.jsonl: ONE JSON object per case, GATED fields only (verify.py GATED_FIELDS) -- must be byte-identical across run01/run02 for a given case id
raw_record_schema.01_detail.jsonl: ONE JSON object per case, NON-GATED (full observed arrays, raw hex, concurrency per-lane mismatch/timeout/completed counts, argv) -- legitimately nondeterministic in detail for concurrency cases per the CONCURRENCY carve-out; not byte-compared
raw_record_schema.01_timing.jsonl: ONE JSON object per case, NON-GATED (duration_ms, stdout/stderr tails)
raw_record_schema.00_env.json: per-run environment snapshot (informational; pinned_revision above is what gates validity)

gates.selftest: verify.py --selftest -- pure Python, one authoritative shared key-set (oracle hand-worked vectors + casematrix structural invariants), runnable in every tree state
gates.seqtest: verify.py --seqtest -- PRE_GPU / RUN01_PRESENT / RUN02_PRESENT from raw/ directory presence
gates.smoke: verify.py --preflight (run01) / --between-runs (run02) -- NON-RECORDED compile+dispatch+compare of one known-good kernel, writes nothing under raw/
gates.captured_compare: verify.py --compare RUN1 RUN2 -- byte-identity of GATED_FIELDS only across the two runs
gates.concurrency_split: GATED_FIELDS carries only the coarse `verdict` (exact/broken/incomplete) for concurrency cases; raw per-lane mismatch/timeout/completed counts live in the sibling 01_detail.jsonl (non-gated); verify.py --selftest asserts this split by construction

process_rules.no_raw_binary: raw/ contains only text/JSON; scratch Metal binary archives and buffer files live under work/<run-id>/ (outside raw/)
process_rules.one_case_one_process: harness/case_exec.py is invoked once per case as a fresh subprocess from run.py
process_rules.append_fflush: run.py opens 01_results.jsonl/01_detail.jsonl/01_timing.jsonl in append mode and flushes after every case
process_rules.no_run_id_reuse: run.py refuses to start into a non-empty existing run directory
process_rules.no_post_capture_repair: raw/ captures, once written, are never hand-edited; a defective run is quarantined and a NEW run id captures the replacement
process_rules.each_experiment_own_process: tools/* are read-only; this experiment never edits them
process_rules.no_git_commits: this experiment does not call git commit; the orchestrator reviews and commits
